generated_for: Simon Anderson Surfboards official named model catalog

brands.name: Simon Anderson Surfboards
brands.location_label: North Narrabeen / Brookvale, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Beautifully crafted high-performance surfboards from the mind that changed surfing forever. Established North Narrabeen 1971. Hand-shaped in Australia.

models.name: Varmit
models.description: Varmit is a fuller volume performance board with extra width through the nose and overall plan shape, combined with a rounded square tail, single to double concave and smooth modern rocker.

models.name: Alley
models.description: Developed to maximize speed, carve and aerial potential. Generous nose and tail area with rounded square tail, vee deck to low boxy rail, deep single concave throughout.

models.name: NXFC
models.description: Modern high-performance shortboard combining speed, responsiveness, and control. Rounded square tail, balanced nose & tail planshape, single to double concave low soft rails. Best suited to 2–5ft surf as a Thruster.

models.name: 5 Spark
models.description: Swallow tail performance fish with Thruster or Quad fin options. Features streamlined fish outline, flatter deck, low soft rails, single to double concave, vee through the tail and a smooth medium rocker.

models.name: Mollusc
models.description: A fuller outline performance shortboard with added area through the nose and round tail. Features a single to double concave, low entry rocker, medium tail rocker, and slightly fuller low soft rails.

models.name: Mollusc Robo
models.description: A stretched-out version of Mollusc, designed to add paddle power and wave-catching ability while retaining a performance feel. Developed from the Mollusc as a higher-volume performance board and an alternative to surfing a Mini Mal.

models.name: Face Dancer
models.description: A good all-rounder customized over the years to surf up as a semi-gun, or down as a smaller wave performance board for a one board quiver. Quad option, good wave Thruster. Slightly increased area in the nose, normal width in the round tail.

models.name: DSC & DSCV
models.description: Step-up or Semi-gun rounded pin Thruster, but can be a Quad option board. Rocker is smooth and moderate with slight single to double concave and low soft rail. DSCV is a similar design but has vee in the back half of the board. DSC has been around since 1994, slowly evolving as a dependable all purpose good wave board. DSCV was introduced as a bigger board semi gun option.
